card.name: Start of the word reconstituted
card.fires_on: The first piece "re" of reconstitute, reconstituted or reconstitution, in directions for preparing powdered injectable drugs. It often follows "the", "be" or "for".

modes.label: After "the"
modes.description: "re" begins reconstituted before "solution" or a drug name.
modes.example: vial(s) containing 100 mg of Provocholine powder. Shake the vial to obtain a clear solution. Dilute the<< re>>constituted Provocholine solution

modes.label: Capitalized heading or verb
modes.description: "Re" begins Reconstitution or Reconstitute in table headers and instructions.
modes.example: is between 3 mg/mL to 3.5 mg/mL Vial Size Route of Administration Amount of Sterile Water for Injection, USP for<< Re>>constitution Concentration After Reconstitution 5

card.writes: It promotes the "re" start of words like reconstruct and rebuild, which pushes the model to finish the word as reconstitute.
card.plain: It fires on the opening "re" of "reconstituted" in instructions for mixing powdered injection drugs.
